body.name: shared stochastic hard intervention
body.construction: For every \(I\subseteq V\) and \(\ell\in L\), \(\mathcal G_{\ell,I}=(V,\{(u,v)\in E(\mathcal G_\ell):v\notin I\})\) and \(P_{\ell,I}(dx_V)=\prod_{i\in I}q_i(dx_i)\prod_{i\in V\setminus I}\kappa_{\ell i}(dx_i\mid x_{\operatorname{pa}_\ell(i)})\); the same \(q_i\) is used in every component and every intervention containing \(i\).
